subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Which public provider-family fallback contract should OpenClaw support for default text model failover: wildcard/auto refs, explicit fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived fallbacks, or no new core config surface?
rationale: This changes a public config/provider-routing contract with cost, quality, auth, and upgrade implications; the code can be implemented once the product contract is chosen, but automation should not choose that contract implicitly.

options.title: Choose one canonical contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product review, pick the supported contract, and require implementation to update schema, runtime gates, docs, and tests consistently.

options.title: Narrow to catalog-derived fallbacks
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 only if maintainers decide catalog-derived fallbacks are the desired subset and the PR is repaired and proven.

options.title: Keep explicit fallbacks only
options.body: Decline new provider-family fallback syntax and document explicit fallbacks plus provider wildcard allowlists as the supported operator path.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer product review, pick the supported contract, and require implementation to update schema, runtime gates, docs, and tests consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal on model fallback resolution and recent source-contract wording for this area.
